item.text: {"analysis":"The supplied arena observations show Morgana E spending 140 mana and Ahri Q spending 110, while cooldown rejection checks pass. Combat.BeginCast explicitly subtracts twice ChampionKit.Mana. Remove that multiplier so accepted casts charge the listed cost once, preserving existing validation, cooldowns, and ability effects. Host replay is required to verify the proposal.","edits":[{"path":"Assets/Dex/Runtime/Combat.cs","find":"            source.mana-=2*ChampionKit.Mana(source.champion,slot);","replace":"            source.mana-=ChampionKit.Mana(source.champion,slot);","create":false}]}
